text.tspan: Checks PD voltage before enabling the motor.
Internal clock avoids an external crystal.
USB-C PD sink requests a 15 V motor supply.
PG reports a completed power negotiation.
Creates 3.3 V for MCU and driver logic.
Diode OR accepts either USB data power or PD.
Two current-regulated bridges drive the coils.
0.25 ohm sense resistors set phase current.
Clamps ESD on USB D+ and D- at the data port.
VBUS pin references the USB protection diodes.
PD PORT: motor power, 15 V requested. DATA PORT: USB computer control.
Motor: 14HM11-0404S, bipolar, 0.4 A/phase. Prototype: firmware/bench/rear-fit validation pending.

svg.text: SHEET 6/9 - C_LDO_IN, C_LDO_OUT, C_CP, C_VCP, C_VREG, C_DRV_LOGIC
Named nets connect across all pages. NC = intentionally unconnected pin.
